visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a round pan on a portable stove, containing several slices of marbled raw beef topped with green leafy vegetables. Large text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) A black kettle pours a dark, semi-transparent brown sauce over the raw beef and vegetables. The beef is layered over white onions and other greens. (3) A pair of wooden chopsticks lifts a cooked slice of beef, showing its tender texture and sauce coating. (4) The cooked beef is dipped into a small ceramic bowl containing a bright yellow raw egg yolk. (5) The beef, coated in egg yolk, is placed on top of a large bowl of steamed white rice. (6) The beef is then dipped into a separate bowl containing a thick, white creamy liquid, identified as yam puree. (7) Wide shot showing the interior of a brightly lit restaurant with wooden tables and customers, including a man in a striped shirt sitting with his back to the camera. (8) A hand points at a colorful menu card showcasing a 'Summer Sukiyaki' promotion with photos of beef and prices in Japanese Yen. (9) The camera pans across the restaurant's entrance, showing wooden walls, Japanese signage with the name '北斗', and small blue flags. (10) A finger points to the 'SUKIYAKI Wagyu Beef' section on a building directory located inside what looks like an elevator lobby or mall entrance. (11) Final return to the close-up of the raw marbled beef in the pan.
